outcome: Regulation of osteogenesis-related signaling pathways (BMP, TGF-b, WNT/b-catenin)
cohort: The study utilized human amniotic membrane-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hAM-MSCs).
finding: The study identified a novel miRNA expression signature for osteoblast differentiation of hAM-MSCs, highlighting that specific miRNAs act as potential inhibitors or activators of osteogenesis and demonstrating a regulatory role for the miR-204/TGF-bR2 axis.
